chapter_level: Standing pull toward a tacked-on બોધ: the book's own closing ચર્ચા-વિચારણા box is literally titled 'સત્યમેવ જયતે', and 01_meta.json's genre_signals.exercises notes the સાચા-ખોટાની થીમ echoes into the સ્વાધ્યાય itself. This makes profile Avoid item 3 (no tacked-on બોધ) the chapter's biggest single hazard — every explanation, summary and recall answer must stay with what this particular કિશોર did, felt and calculated, never resolve into a stand-alone 'સાચું બોલવું જોઈએ' or 'સત્ય જીતે છે' sentence, however close the book's own apparatus comes to inviting exactly that.

Do not import outside historical/geographic fact: 01_meta.json's own extraction_notes describe મોડાસા-તલોદ-ઈડર-ખેડબ્રહ્મા as 'the historic Modasa-Talod-Idar narrow-gauge line' — that is Agent 1's own research aside, not printed anywhere in this chapter's original_chunk or apparatus. Per profile Avoid item 9, no explanation, summary or recall answer may add this or any other outside fact about the railway line; the place names are used exactly as the text uses them, nothing more.

Dialect and register stay exactly as printed everywhere they are quoted (profile Avoid item 7): 'બી' (M1.S1.T1), the elided 'કે’'/'કે છે' (M1.S1.T2, M2.S2.T3, M2.S2.T4, M2.S2.T5), and 'કો’ક'/'કો’તો' (M2.S2.T5) are all genuine printed licence, already verified against the render per 05_with_content.json's own notes — and the one genuine transcription DEFECT this chapter had ('પોઠ'/'કહં છે', corrected to 'પીઠે … કહે છે') must stay corrected, never reintroduced by a downstream agent copying an older draft.

The porter's, crowd's and ગાડીવાળાની mockery and testimony (M2.S2.T3–M2.S2.T5) are working people doing their job or speaking as bystanders, not villains or figures of fun for the reader — profile Avoid item 14 and global_content_rules rule 10 both apply: no field should flatten the porter into a bully or the crowd into 'ખરાબ લોકો', since the chapter's own ending has this same crowd turn respectful ('માન ભરી નજરે').
